headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points as inflation concerns weighed on Indian equities

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 17 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on market sentiment during the last session.
Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices had provided support earlier in the week.
Positive Q2 earnings expectations and strong FII buying boosted equities mid-week.
Global cues and Gift Nifty signals influenced daily opening trends.
whatHappening: On the last trading day (Friday, 13 Nov), Sensex dropped 289 points while Nifty slipped.
For the weekly wrap up to 14 Nov, NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended their rally for the third consecutive week.
PSU Banks emerged as the top sectoral gainers over the weekly trading period.
Earlier in the week on Wednesday, market capitalization surged by Rs 4.5 lakh crore in early trade.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices closed lower with the Sensex falling 289 points amid rising inflation concerns. Despite the Friday dip, both NIFTY50 and SENSEX secured gains for the third straight week, driven by PSU banks and strong mid-week FII inflows. Stock markets are closed today for the weekend.
